# Test data

## GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb

Copied unmodified from the [maxmind/MaxMind-DB](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB) repository
(`test-data/GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb`).

It is a genuine MaxMind-format country database, where the country code lives at `country.iso_code` (not at the
top-level `country_code` field used by some third-party mirrors).
